meta.title: Heritage — Whizzzest
meta.description: Explore five examples of Wanzai’s intangible cultural heritage, from fireworks craftsmanship to Desheng Drum music and Xiabu weaving.

hero.title: Living Heritage
hero.subtitle: Five living traditions from Wanzai, Jiangxi

itemsDesc: Explore four nationally listed traditions and one recognized by Jiangxi Province. Each guide includes a video.

items.title: Wanzai fireworks
items.summary: A craft with centuries of history in Wanzai, from small firecrackers to elaborate public displays.

items.title: Desheng Drum
items.summary: A folk ensemble tradition combining suona melodies with the rhythms of drums, gongs and cymbals.

items.title: Xiabu weaving
items.summary: A handweaving tradition that turns ramie fiber into a light, breathable summer cloth.

items.title: Kaikou Nuo
items.summary: Wanzai’s masked ritual theater combines singing, speech, movement and stylized combat.

items.title: Zhipeng folk songs
items.summary: The folk songs of bamboo papermakers, shaped by the rhythm of their work in the paper sheds.

items.title: Heritage experiences
items.summary: See which demonstrations and workshops are being planned.

cta.title: Experience the heritage
cta.desc: Plan a visit to Wanzai to see how these arts are practiced today.
